notes: The ABI experiment is GNU-assembled and GCC-linked, not emitted by Sutram.
Static libc eliminates shared libc dependency but embeds the C runtime into the executable, which changes the shipped no-runtime principle.
Plain linker failure is expected and must not be counted as a test failure of the Sutram compiler.
WS2 module system is a bounded one-page design, NOT implementation.
WS3 comments are ignored in current compiler; proposed strict profile must opt in to native static checking; typed phal<> and prasar are proposals.
Existing R84 Python gate passed its own 12/12 tests in earlier round, not re-executed now.
